ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Federal Funding Freezes on Local Communities
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the Trump administration's funding freezes on local communities, including the Gateway tunnel project and the Juneau housing project.
questions: What are the specific projects affected by the funding freezes?
How will these freezes impact local economies and communities?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant concerns about the administration's priorities and the impact on local communities. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can uncover the motivations behind these funding freezes and the effects on the ground.
